desc: Bazil's Armor: Bazil Thredd's Defias armour: dark slate-grey leather jerkin with riveted bands, padded grey-green pauldrons with rivets, a brown studded belt with a buckle, dark red trousers

Mutanus Hood: a cute homemade costume hood shaped like Mutanus the Devourer, a giant murloc: teal-blue plush with fins on top and at the sides, two big goggly felt eyes on top, a wide gaping felt mouth with little teeth framing the face; the face fully visible through the opening. The hood ends at the jaw, like a hat: no neck or shoulder part

Murloc Onesie: a cute homemade murloc onesie costume in teal-blue plush with scale stitching, a pale cream belly panel, felt fins on the arms and a fin down the back sticking out, stitched seams; just the body suit (no hood)

Arugal's Cowl: Archmage Arugal's look: a dark charcoal hood with a tall silver crest of two curved horns rising from the brow, and a dark cloth mask over the nose and mouth (covering the tusks), the eyes uncovered
Arugal's Robe: Archmage Arugal's robes: long black robes with silver bands and buckles down the front, big spiky dark pauldrons with sickly glowing yellow-green tips sticking out past the shoulders

Aku'mai Hood: a cute homemade costume hood shaped like Aku'mai the hydra's head, made of quilted padded fabric like a puffer jacket in blue-grey: a pale spiky padded crest on top, embroidered eyes stitched on top, padded jaws with cream teeth framing the face; the face fully visible. The hood ends at the jaw, like a hat: no neck or shoulder part

Aku'mai Shell: a cute homemade turtle-shell costume like Aku'mai, made of quilted padded fabric like a puffer jacket: a big dark blue-grey padded shell with soft spikes on the back, sticking out past the shoulders, a pale quilted belly panel in front with a big chunky zipper up the middle and a little fish-shaped zip pull (a zipper, NO buttons); just the body suit

Mekgineer's Helm: Mekgineer Thermaplugg's mech cockpit helmet: a rounded orange-red riveted metal helmet with two orange spikes on top and big round glowing yellow-green goggle lenses pushed up on the brow, open-faced

Mekgineer's Mech Suit: Mekgineer Thermaplugg's battle mech worn as armour: bulky orange-red riveted metal plates with big orange spikes on the round shoulders, steel joints and pistons, a round glowing reactor in the chest
Thalnos's Robe: Bloodmage Thalnos's tattered crimson Scarlet robe with dark red trim, its hem in rags with ghostly orange-red flames licking up
Herod's Plate: Herod's look: a bare chest crossed by a red leather harness, big red Scarlet Crusade pauldrons with gold trim, red bracers, a red belt and red plate on the legs; lots of bare skin
Whitemane's Locks: High Inquisitor Whitemane's short silver-white bob haircut under a small round red and gold priest's cap
Whitemane's Robes: High Inquisitor Whitemane's red and white robes with gold trim, small spiked red shoulder pads, long red gloves and a red sash
Coldbringer Shroud: Amnennar the Coldbringer's lich robes: dark blue tattered robes with bone skull clasps, jagged pale blue frost shards and ice on the shoulders, frost mist at the hem
Archaedas's Stoneskin: armour of rough brown-grey stone slabs like the titan stone keeper Archaedas, glowing blue cracks and titan runes, huge stone shoulders sticking out
Ukorz's Mohawk: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp's tall spiky red troll mohawk rising out of a red and black horned headpiece with curved silver horns, open-faced
Sandscalp Plate: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp's red and black troll armour with silver spikes and curved silver horns on the shoulders, bands of red armour on the arms and belly
Theradras's Gown: Princess Theradras's gown of brown earth and rock with mossy patches, big purple amethyst crystals bursting out of the shoulders and hem

Thaurissan's Crown: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan's tall red and gold crown, and a huge long braided black dwarf beard hanging down over the chest, covering the mouth and chin (covering the tusks), the eyes uncovered
Thaurissan's Robes: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan's black and gold emperor's robes with red and gold patterned trim, big red pauldrons edged in gold, a wide gold belt
Omokk's Helm: Highlord Omokk's dark iron ogre war helm with a crown of big silver spikes on top, open-faced
Drakkisath's Helm: General Drakkisath's tall orange-red dragon-head headdress with swept-back pale horns and a fin crest, open-faced
Alzzin's Fur: Alzzin the Wildshaper's satyr look: shaggy dark brown goat-fur leggings up to the waist, a bare chest, dark twisting fel vines with glowing fel flowers draped over the shoulders
Tortheldrin's Locks: Prince Tortheldrin's long straight pale blond elven hair falling past the shoulders, parted in the middle
Balnazzar's Wings: dreadlord armour of dark purple and black spiked plates, and huge leathery dark purple bat wings spreading out wide behind the shoulders

Dirgehammer's Beard: Durgen Dirgehammer, a Dark Iron dwarf: a big braided red beard hanging down, covering the mouth and chin (covering the tusks), red hair, and round goggles with red lenses pushed up on the brow, the eyes uncovered

Dirgehammer's Harness: Durgen Dirgehammer's dark grey iron armour: a heavy harness of big iron rings and chain links over the bare chest, studded leather straps, a wide iron belt with a big ring buckle, and chunky oversized dark iron bracers wrapping the whole forearms

Rath'mael's Skull: a cheap shop-bought party costume hood of shiny polyester shaped like the skeleton mage Rath'mael's skull: bone-white with printed-on dark eye sockets on top and a shiny pale blue flame of satin rising from the crown, the face fully visible through the opening. The hood ends at the jaw, like a hat

Rath'mael's Robes: a cheap shop-bought skeleton mage party costume of shiny polyester: a ribcage PRINTED on the black chest, flimsy spiky grey pauldrons, long tattered crimson robe, closed with velcro at the side, a paper price tag still hanging off one sleeve
Guardian Helm: a titan stone keeper's helm of carved grey stone, square and blocky, with glowing deep teal rune bands across the brow, open-faced
Guardian Stoneskin: the Relic Guardian's body of carved grey stone blocks with huge boulder shoulders sticking out, a carved stone belt and glowing deep teal rune bands
Tortheldrin's Armor: Prince Tortheldrin's Highborne armour in orange, olive green and dark red tiger-like stripes, curved striped shoulder pads, fitted to the body
Bazil's Locks: Bazil Thredd's look: long straight black hair falling past the shoulders, and a red cloth mask pulled DOWN around the neck under the chin (the whole face uncovered)

Mutanus Hood: a cute homemade costume hood shaped like Mutanus the Devourer, a giant murloc, HAND-KNITTED in chunky teal-blue wool like grandma made it: knitted fins on top and at the sides with a pom-pom on the top fin, two big googly eyes on top, a wide knitted mouth with little felt teeth framing the face; the face fully visible. The hood ends at the jaw, like a hat: no neck or shoulder part

Murloc Onesie: a cute murloc onesie costume HAND-KNITTED in chunky teal-blue wool like grandma made it, cable-knit patterns, a cream knitted belly panel, knitted fins on the arms and a fin down the back sticking out, closed with wooden toggles on loops like a duffle coat; just the body suit (no hood)
